summary: Day: 2011 elevated end-zone game view (field upper-middle). Night: 2015 elevated sideline under lights.

files.author: Tony Faiola

files.note: Elevated end-zone corner view from the south-west lower bowl during the 2011 Indiana game, full crowd; field rows ~420-1150 of 1708 (25-67%) running away from camera, stands wrap both sides, sky top ~5%; crowd fills the bottom third. Classic framing, field in the upper-middle

files.author: Steven Depolo from Grand Rapids, MI, USA
files.credit_line: Photo: Steven Depolo from Grand Rapids, MI, USA, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
files.note: Night 2015 Penn State game from high in the west stands toward the north end; field rows ~1150-1800 of 1800 (from ~38% down to the bottom, diagonal), packed far stands rows ~550-1150, black sky with a light flare top-centre ~30%; fans' heads in the lower right

closest_misses.why: 2025 night from the upper lower-bowl, field rows ~45-80%, but identifiable fans fill the bottom-left third
2025 sunset, field only in the bottom 35% below a huge press box
